notes: Open-end ETF shell reorganization (N-14 filed by Tidal ETF Trust): American Customer Satisfaction ETF (series of ETF Series Solutions) into a newly created, identically named series of Tidal ETF Trust; one target. Ticker printed as ACSI in the letter and the comparison table; one later passage says 'under the ticker symbol ASCI' (apparent typo), so ACSI is used. n_targets = 1 is read from the single 'Target Fund' the filing names, not from a printed count. Conditions listed are the two the summary names (shareholder approval; Godfrey & Kahn tax opinion); the Plan's own conditions article falls after the excerpt cut (excerpt ends in Section 4.1 of Appendix A), so further categories may exist. Section 3.2(c) postpones the Closing if the NYSE is closed or trading is disrupted; treated as a postponement clause, not a closing condition. No outside/termination date stated; Plan may be terminated at any time by mutual consent. Closing per Plan Section 3.1: 9:30 a.m. Eastern on May 24, 2021 or another agreed date. Record date March 1, 2021: 1,600,000 shares outstanding, NAV $45.75.
